facts.fact: Decree 2025-814 of 30 July 2025 is made under Law No. 2014-038 of 9 January 2015 on personal data protection, applying its articles 29.1 and 29.2.
facts.system: Law No. 2014-038 on personal data protection

facts.fact: Decree 2025-814 of 30 July 2025 records the election and designation of eight members of the Commission Malagasy de l'Informatique et des Libertés.
facts.system: Commission Malagasy de l'Informatique et des Libertés

facts.fact: Decree 2025-814 cites Decree 2023-1541 of 6 December 2023 on the CMIL's powers, organisation and personal data processing, with only its article 90 repealed by Decree 2025-696 of 18 June 2025.

systems.system: Commission Malagasy de l'Informatique et des Libertés
